summary: The change adds several queued messages that can each be withdrawn into the draft, and a persistent "Interrupted by user" entry when the user stops a run. It also makes bash cancellation kill detached descendants through a run-ID scan. The earlier findings F1–F3 are resolved. The new temp tests cover the remaining changed lines: harness withdraw and save failures mapped to BAD_REQUEST, an ESRCH-tolerant group signal with no warning, a transport abort with no error banner, and the submit guard. All test runs pass and the coverage gate passes, so the change is ready.
